text_block_list.text: One night. In the Ritto Dormitory—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Craft-chaaan! Let's play building blocks, building blocks!
Let's make an even bigger castle than yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Craft-chan? Craft...
Huh? Where is she?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, done at last.
After one painstaking hour, it is finally complete.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Look upon this magnificent blow-dry!
Now this is a first-rate hairstyle!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
King-chan, King-chaaan!
I'm all alone!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Urara-san? I haven't the slightest idea what you mean.
In short... what is the matter?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I see, Craft-san hasn't
returned yet. However...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I have a fairly good idea where she is.
Yes, surely...

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Again...
I plunged in way too fast on the corner again...

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
One more time...! No, as many times as it takes
until I get it! I just have to keep racking up reps!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Craft-san. Naughty girl.
Staying out on the track until this hour.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, King-san! I'm sorry!
I just got completely absorbed in training.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
I'm not first-rate like you, King-san,
so unless I push myself like this...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmph, 'unlike me,' is it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Granted, there may be a gap between us at this present moment.
However...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I believe you and I are quite similar.
Including how you charge in too aggressively, just like a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you were watching...? 
Wait, King-san, you too?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. There were times I lost my composure and pushed far too hard as well.
And precisely because I've made the same mistakes...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
there may be things I can teach you.
Such as how to discipline yourself at the corners.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Come, Craft-san.
I shall be your partner.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really, is that okay?!
But King-san, you're still in your uniform...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A first-rate lady pays no heed
to what happens to her clothes.
Come at me, don't hold back!

text_block_list.name: King & Craft
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaah!
Taaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Right here, Craft-san!
At this exact moment, prepare for your next acceleration!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to suppress your aggressive spirit!
Simply channel it into your next attack!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: Yes, King-san!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
(Amazing, King-san...!
She understands my feelings
as if they were in the palm of her hand.)

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
(Is this what being first-rate means?
No, it's definitely because King-san went through
a phase just like mine...!)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Craft-san!
Yes, just like that!
See, you can do it when you try.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Yes... King-san!
!

Their dedication to training is commendable.
However, now that I've found them,
I couldn't just let them continue late into the night.
choice_data_list: You two, let's call it a day and continue tomorrow... okay?

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm so sorry!
We got carried away...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let us wrap it up for tonight.
Let us head back, Craft-san.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...!
Ehehe, I feel kind of happy.
Not only did you teach me, but we're walking back together too.

A senior and junior who resemble each other in so many ways.
I watched over their backs as they headed home side by side in harmony.
